subject: bia
title: BIA.------AFI.
description: Chart 1 of 2 on book p. 341 (PCC-25). BIA (bi-aitional) is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of"; AFI (affinity insight) is the partner. From the subject: C-INFO (composite information), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of". From AFI: ACT (activism) and DYM-F (dynamic functionalism). AFI-2 (affinity insight—second degree) is on a dotted line from AFI. AFI-1 (affinity insight—first degree) is on a dotted line from AFI. From C-INFO: PROG-CONT (progressional continuance) and AFI. From AFI-2: SOC-RT (social reality). From DYM-F: COS-P (cosmic particulars). From AFI-1: PR-TRS. From PROG-CONT: ATTN (attraction), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of".
